name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A set of instructions that turns an AI coding assistant into an automated security auditor for a codebase.
buyer: A startup CTO who needs a security review before a SOC2 audit or a big customer's security questionnaire but can't afford a full pentest firm yet.
business_use_cases: A boutique security consultancy uses it to run faster first-pass audits for clients, then sells a human-verified report on top, cutting their own delivery time.
A startup runs it before every major release as a security gate, then shows the resulting clean report to enterprise customers as proof of due diligence.
An agency packages 'AI-assisted security audit plus fix' as a fixed-price add-on service for client codebases.

money_ideas.idea: Fixed-price AI-assisted security audit service for startups preparing for SOC2 or enterprise sales
Subscription security-audit-as-a-service that re-runs on every release

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'AI security audit' service this weekend to indie SaaS founders who've never had a security review — run this against their repo and hand them a clean findings report.
